label: Updated 8 AM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: DeChambeau, Rahm Gain Leverage
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau and Jon Rahm have leverage as PGA Tour's Schwab Challenge lacks stars with Scheffler and McIlroy out, while they play LIV Golf in Korea; DeChambeau considers YouTube full-time amid return talks.

items.headline: Soo Bin Joo Leads ShopRite LPGA
items.text: Soo Bin Joo shot 3-under 68 in tough seaside winds with only one bogey to stretch her ShopRite LPGA lead to four shots at 8-under 134 after two rounds.
